CustomField.description: Tier__c collapsed per the Reports Module spec's Segment Analysis rule: an HCP with no real tier assigned (Tier__c = 'None') counts as Bronze for reporting, rather than forming its own group. Only covers HCPs that have a Segmentation__c record at all -- an HCP with no Segmentation__c record shows as its own blank group in an outer-joined report, same as any other "no related record" case.
CustomField.label: Tier Group
